paragraphs.en: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.

paragraphs.en: Go from typing claude to orchestrating agents, hooks, skills, and MCP servers — with visual tutorials, copy-paste templates, and a guided learning path.

paragraphs.en: You installed Claude Code. You ran a few prompts. Now what?

paragraphs.en: You're leaving 90% of Claude Code's power on the table — and you don't know what you don't know.

paragraphs.en: This isn't another feature reference. It's a structured, visual, example-driven guide that teaches you to use every Claude Code feature with real-world templates you can copy into your project today.
paragraphs.zh: 这不是又一份功能参考文档。 它是一份结构化、可视化、以示例驱动的指南，教你使用 Claude Code 的每一项功能，并提供可以今天就复制到自己项目中的真实场景模板。

paragraphs.en: Installation note : Starting in v2.1.113, Claude Code ships as a native per-platform binary (macOS/Linux/Windows). The recommended install is the native installer ( curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash ); npm installation is deprecated in the official README; prefer the native installer, Homebrew ( brew install --cask claude-code ) or WinGet ( winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode ). For reference, npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code pulls the same native binary through a per-platform optional dependency at install time. As of v2.1.116, downloads come from https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases — corporate proxies must allowlist this host.
paragraphs.zh: 安装说明：从 v2.1.113 开始，Claude Code 以原生各平台二进制文件（macOS/Linux/Windows）形式发布。 推荐使用原生安装器（curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash）进行安装；官方 README 已弃用 npm 安装方式；建议使用原生安装器、Homebrew（brew install --cask claude-code）或 WinGet（winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode）。 供参考：npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code 会在安装时通过各平台可选依赖拉取同一个原生二进制文件。 自 v2.1.116 起，下载来源于 https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases —— 企业代理必须将该主机加入允许列表。

paragraphs.en: # 1. Clone the guide git clone https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto.git cd claude-howto # 2. Copy your first slash command mkdir -p /path/to/your-project/.claude/commands cp 01-slash-commands/optimize.md /path/to/your-project/.claude/commands/ # 3. paragraphs.zh: 内容：以 Markdown 文件形式存储的用户调用的快捷方式

paragraphs.en: cp 01-slash-commands/ * .md /path/to/project/.claude/commands/ Usage :
paragraphs.zh: cp 01-slash-commands/*.md /path/to/project/.claude/commands/ 用法：

paragraphs.en: /optimize /pr /generate-api-docs Learn More : Discovering Claude Code Slash Commands
paragraphs.zh: /optimize /pr /generate-api-docs 了解更多：探索 Claude Code 斜杠命令

paragraphs.en: What : Persistent context across sessions
paragraphs.zh: What : 跨会话的持久上下文

paragraphs.en: # Project memory cp 02-memory/project-CLAUDE.md /path/to/project/CLAUDE.md # Directory memory cp 02-memory/directory-api-CLAUDE.md /path/to/project/src/api/CLAUDE.md # Personal memory cp 02-memory/personal-CLAUDE.md ~ /.claude/CLAUDE.md Usage : Automatically loaded by Claude
paragraphs.zh: # 项目记忆 cp 02-memory/project-CLAUDE.md /path/to/project/CLAUDE.md # 目录记忆 cp 02-memory/directory-api-CLAUDE.md /path/to/project/src/api/CLAUDE.md # 个人记忆 cp 02-memory/personal-CLAUDE.md ~ /.claude/CLAUDE.md 用法：由 Claude 自动加载

paragraphs.en: What : Reusable, auto-invoked capabilities with instructions and scripts
paragraphs.zh: What：可复用、可自动调用的能力，附带指令和脚本

paragraphs.en: # Personal skills cp -r 03-skills/code-review-specialist ~ /.claude/skills/ # Project skills cp -r 03-skills/code-review-specialist /path/to/project/.claude/skills/ Usage : Automatically invoked when relevant
paragraphs.zh: # 个人技能 cp -r 03-skills/code-review-specialist ~ /.claude/skills/ # 项目技能 cp -r 03-skills/code-review-specialist /path/to/project/.claude/skills/ 用法：在相关时自动调用

paragraphs.en: What : Specialized AI assistants with isolated contexts and custom prompts
paragraphs.zh: What：具有隔离上下文和自定义提示词的专用 AI 助手

paragraphs.en: cp 04-subagents/ * .md /path/to/project/.claude/agents/ Usage : Automatically delegated by main agent
paragraphs.zh: cp 04-subagents/ * .md /path/to/project/.claude/agents/ 用法：由主智能体自动委派

paragraphs.en: What : Model Context Protocol for accessing external tools and APIs
paragraphs.zh: What：用于访问外部工具和 API 的模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）

paragraphs.en: # Set environment variables export DATABASE_URL= " postgresql://... " # Add MCP server via CLI claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header " Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GITHUB_PAT " # Or add to project .mcp.json manually (see 05-mcp/ for examples) Usage : MCP tools are automatically available to Claude once configured
paragraphs.zh: # 设置环境变量 export DATABASE_URL= " postgresql://... " # 通过 CLI 添加 MCP 服务器 claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header " Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GITHUB_PAT " # 或者手动添加到项目的 .mcp.json 中（示例见 05-mcp/） 用法：配置完成后，MCP 工具会自动对智能体可用

paragraphs.en: What : Event-driven shell commands that execute automatically in response to Claude Code events
paragraphs.zh: What：事件驱动的 shell 命令，可自动执行以响应 Claude Code 事件

paragraphs.en: mkdir -p ~ /.claude/hooks cp 06-hooks/ * .sh ~ /.claude/hooks/ chmod +x ~ /.claude/hooks/ * .sh Configure hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json :
paragraphs.zh: mkdir -p ~/.claude/hooks cp 06-hooks/*.sh ~/.claude/hooks/ chmod +x ~/.claude/hooks/*.sh 在 ~/.claude/settings.json 中配置钩子（hooks）：

paragraphs.en: { "hooks" : { "PostToolUse" : [ { "matcher" : " Write " , "hooks" : [ { "type" : " command " , "command" : " ~/.claude/hooks/format-code.sh " }, { "type" : " command " , "command" : " ~/.claude/hooks/security-scan.sh " } ] } ] } } Usage : Hooks execute automatically on events
paragraphs.zh: { "hooks" : { "PostToolUse" : [ { "matcher" : " Write " , "hooks" : [ { "type" : " command " , "command" : " ~/.claude/hooks/format-code.sh " }, { "type" : " command " , "command" : " ~/.claude/hooks/security-scan.sh " } ] } ] } } 用法：钩子会在事件发生时自动执行

paragraphs.en: Hook Types (5): command , http , prompt , mcp_tool , agent — how a hook runs.
paragraphs.zh: 钩子类型（5 种）：command、http、prompt、mcp_tool、agent —— 钩子的运行方式。

paragraphs.en: What : Complete command-line interface reference for Claude Code
paragraphs.zh: 什么是：Claude Code 的完整命令行界面参考

paragraphs.en: # Interactive mode claude " explain this project " # Print mode (non-interactive) claude -p " review this code " # Process file content cat error.log | claude -p " explain this error " # JSON output for scripts claude -p --output-format json " list functions " # Resume session claude -r " feature-auth " " continue implementation " Use Cases : CI/CD pipeline integration, script automation, batch processing, multi-session workflows, custom agent configurations
paragraphs.zh: # 交互模式 claude " 解释这个项目 " # 打印模式（非交互） claude -p " 审查这段代码 " # 处理文件内容 cat error.log | claude -p " 解释这个错误 " # 用于脚本的 JSON 输出 claude -p --output-format json " 列出函数 " # 恢复会话 claude -r " feature-auth " " 继续实现 " 使用场景：CI/CD 流水线集成、脚本自动化、批量处理、多会话工作流、自定义智能体配置

paragraphs.en: # Uses: Slash Commands + Subagents + Memory + MCP User: /review-pr Claude: 1 . Loads project memory (coding standards) 2 . Fetches PR via GitHub MCP 3 . Delegates to code-reviewer subagent 4 . Delegates to test-engineer subagent 5 . Synthesizes findings 6 . Provides comprehensive review Automated Documentation # Uses: Skills + Subagents + Memory User: "Generate API documentation for the auth module" Claude: 1 . Loads project memory (doc standards) 2 . Detects doc generation request 3 . Auto-invokes doc-generator skill 4 . Delegates to api-documenter subagent 5 . Creates comprehensive docs with examples DevOps Deployment # Uses: Plugins + MCP + Hooks User: /deploy production Claude: 1 . Runs pre-deploy hook (validates environment) 2 . Delegates to deployment-specialist subagent 3 . Executes deployment via Kubernetes MCP 4 . Monitors progress 5 . Runs post-deploy hook (health checks) 6 .
paragraphs.zh: # 使用方式：斜杠命令 + 子智能体 + 记忆 + MCP 用户：/review-pr Claude：1. 加载项目记忆（编码规范）2. 通过 GitHub MCP 获取 PR 3. 委派给代码审查子智能体 4. 委派给测试工程师子智能体 5. 综合整理审查结果 6. 提供全面的审查 自动化文档 # 使用方式：技能 + 子智能体 + 记忆 用户："为认证模块生成 API 文档" Claude：1. 加载项目记忆（文档规范）2. 检测到文档生成请求 3. 自动调用文档生成技能 4. 委派给 API 文档编写子智能体 5. 创建包含示例的完整文档 DevOps 部署 # 使用方式：插件 + MCP + 钩子 用户：/deploy production Claude：1. 运行部署前钩子（校验环境）2. 委派给部署专家子智能体 3. 通过 Kubernetes MCP 执行部署 4. 监控进度 5. 运行部署后钩子（健康检查）6.

paragraphs.en: # Install development dependencies uv pip install -r scripts/requirements-dev.txt # Run all unit tests pytest scripts/tests/ -v # Run tests with coverage report pytest scripts/tests/ -v --cov=scripts --cov-report=html # Run code quality checks ruff check scripts/ ruff format --check scripts/ # Run security scan bandit -c scripts/pyproject.toml -r scripts/ --exclude scripts/tests/ # Run type checking mypy scripts/ --ignore-missing-imports Tests run automatically on every push to main / develop and every PR to main . See TESTING.md for detailed information.
paragraphs.zh: # 安装开发依赖 uv pip install -r scripts/requirements-dev.txt # 运行所有单元测试 pytest scripts/tests/ -v # 运行测试并生成覆盖率报告 pytest scripts/tests/ -v --cov=scripts --cov-report=html # 运行代码质量检查 ruff check scripts/ ruff format --check scripts/ # 运行安全扫描 bandit -c scripts/pyproject.toml -r scripts/ --exclude scripts/tests/ # 运行类型检查 mypy scripts/ --ignore-missing-imports 测试会在每次推送到 main / develop 分支以及每次向 main 分支提交 PR 时自动运行。 详细信息请参见 TESTING.md。
